description: This file defines a custom Swing component HorizontalLine that extends JPanel. It overrides the paint method to draw a centered horizontal line and defines size-related methods to specify its minimum and preferred dimensions.

classes.name: HorizontalLine
classes.description: A custom Swing component that renders a horizontal line centered vertically within its bounds.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Overrides the JPanel paint method to draw a black horizontal line across the component.

methods.name: getMinimumSize
methods.description: Returns the minimum size of the component, set to 150x10 pixels.

methods.name: getPreferredSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred size for the component, same as the minimum size.
